title: FarsEval-PKBETS: A new diverse benchmark for evaluating Persian large language models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's accuracy in answering questions related to Islam, specifically the Shia branch. It also aimed to examine potential bias the model may have towards other sects and religions by covering topics in practical jurisprudence and theoretical beliefs.
findings: For the religion category, Llama3-70B achieved an accuracy of 0.54 (0.57 including semi-correct answers), PersianMind scored 0.29 (0.32), and Dorna scored 0.39 (0.43). This indicates that the models, particularly those fine-tuned for Persian, struggle with questions related to Islam within the Iranian cultural context.
